name: echo-qcoder
description: Governed QCoder launcher and private ChatGPT/Codex control plugin

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web && node ./scripts/evaluate-golden.mjs && npm run test:powerpack
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace server && npm run test:coverage --workspace web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
